description: This file defines the RxProgressDialog class, which provides static methods to create and display a progress dialog in an Android application using RxJava Observables. It manages dialog creation, configuration, and dismissal, encapsulating asynchronous dialog handling.

classes.name: RxProgressDialog
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and manage a progress dialog wrapped in an RxJava Observable.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Observable that manages the lifecycle of a progress dialog, displaying it with specified message and layout, and emits the provided data when ready.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overloaded method that creates a progress dialog with default message (null).
